entities.name: Q4WHU0 HmgX
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Aspergillus fumigatus HmgX; identity and query/target coverage are 100%, E-value 3.16e-176.
HmgX is a cytoplasmic accessory factor required for specific activity of 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase HppD in the L-tyrosine degradation pathway.
Sequence length is 256 aa; estimated molecular weight 27.64 kDa; theoretical pI 5.28; predicted charge at pH 7 is -7.95; GRAVY is -0.320.
No Pfam domain result was available; this is inconclusive for domain absence.

entities.name: Tyrosine catabolism
observations: HmgX participates in fungal L-tyrosine catabolism leading to homogentisic acid metabolism and, under relevant conditions, pyomelanin biosynthesis.

entities.name: Pyomelanin biosynthesis
observations: The HmgX-associated gene cluster mediates formation of fungal pyomelanin from tyrosine-derived homogentisic acid.
